title: Severe Disease in Patients With Recent-Onset Psoriatic Arthritis. Prediction Model Based on Machine Learning
summary: Machine learning estimated severity in people with recent-onset psoriatic arthritis using data from the two-year REAPSER follow-up.
ai_technology: Learned prediction addresses a specific prospective clinical cohort outcome; cross-validation only.
organization: Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material

evidence.tested: The model was assessed by five-fold cross-validation in 158 participants from a prospectively collected cohort.
evidence.unknown: The source did not report independent validation or prospective testing of the fitted model.
